name: ai-config-compress
description: Compress LLM instruction sets, system prompts, rules, and guidelines to reduce token count while preserving behavioral intent. Use this skill whenever the user wants to shorten, truncate, optimize, or compress prompts, system instructions, CLAUDE.md files, custom instructions, rules, guidelines, or any instruction set meant for an LLM. Also trigger when users mention "too many tokens," "prompt is too long," "reduce prompt size," or ask to make instructions more concise.
